name: datasheet-part
about: What the datasheet-to-component run may reach: reads of the project and its checks, edits of the library's drafts, generators and part files, and its own attached documents and working pinout documents. A module left out is out of reach, and so is every entry above its module's class here: publishing (an ask) is. No entry that touches files, settings, the network, the window or a plugin runtime is reached, because reach lists none.
